paragraphs: A mobile-first event ticketing marketplace. Customers discover events and buy tickets (guest checkout, KES). They get one QR-coded ticket per admission, as a PDF and by email. Organizers create and publish events, track sales and commission, and scan guests in from a phone. Admins verify organizers, moderate events, inspect transactions and configure commission. Buyers can also pay in installments with Lipa Mdogo Mdogo (docs/INSTALLMENTS.md), and organizers can design event covers in the AI Banner Studio (docs/AIBANNERS.md).
